meta.title: BCEHS PCP added-scope drugs
meta.note: Not on the EMALB licensing exam; BCEHS practice / school course content

drugs.classificationZh: Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug / NSAID（非甾体抗炎药）
indicationsEn: Severe pain in a multimodal approach
indicationsZh: 重度疼痛时，作为 multimodal approach（多模式镇痛）的一环。
contraindicationsEn: Known hypersensitivity to ketorolac or other anti-inflammatories including aspirin
Known or suspected renal dysfunction (GFR or creatinine clearance less than 30 mL/min, or patient identifies as having kidney dysfunction)
Concern for severe active bleeding (trauma, intracranial hemorrhage, GI bleeding)
Pregnancy
Use of an anticoagulant (e.g., apixaban, rivaroxaban, warfarin, edoxaban, dabigatran)
contraindicationsZh: 对 ketorolac 或其他抗炎药（包括 aspirin）已知过敏。
已知或怀疑肾功能异常：GFR 或 creatinine clearance（肌酐清除率）低于 30 mL/min，或患者自述有肾脏问题。
怀疑存在严重活动性出血（创伤、颅内出血、消化道出血）。
妊娠。
正在使用 anticoagulant（抗凝药），如 apixaban、rivaroxaban、warfarin、edoxaban、dabigatran。
cautionsEn: Severe volume depletion/dehydration
Active cardiac emergency (myocardial infarction)
Anti-inflammatory taken within the last 6-12 hours (e.g., ibuprofen, celecoxib, naproxen)
cautionsZh: 严重容量不足 / 脱水。
正在发生的心脏急症（心肌梗死）。
过去 6-12 小时内用过抗炎药（如 ibuprofen、celecoxib、naproxen）。

doseEn.adult: 10 mg IV/IM. IM as a direct injection; IV undiluted over 15 seconds.
doseEn.pediatric: Age 2-11 years: 0.5 mg/kg IM (maximum single dose 10 mg). PCP pediatric route is IM only.
doseEn.repeat: Adult: may repeat after 6 hours if required. Pediatric: may repeat after 6-8 hours if required.

doseZh.adult: 10 mg IV/IM。IM 直接注射；IV 不稀释，15 秒内推完。
doseZh.pediatric: 2-11 岁：0.5 mg/kg IM（单次最大 10 mg）。PCP 给儿童只能走 IM。
doseZh.repeat: 成人：如需要，6 小时后可重复。儿科：如需要，6-8 小时后可重复。

drugs.onsetEn: IM: onset 20 minutes, duration 6 hours. IV: onset 10 minutes, duration 6 hours.
drugs.onsetZh: IM：起效 20 分钟，持续 6 小时。IV：起效 10 分钟，持续 6 小时。
sideEffectsEn: GI ulcer (low risk with single dose)
sideEffectsZh: 胃肠不适（恶心、呕吐）。
肾功能损害。
出血。
消化道溃疡（单次给药风险低）。
notesEn: Mechanism: non-selective COX-1 and COX-2 inhibition, leading to prostaglandin inhibition and reduced pain, inflammation and fever.
How supplied: 10 mg/mL ampule.
The monograph points to CPG E08 Pain Management and the Clinical Q&A for ketorolac for further guidance.
Licence note: both indications and the adult IV/IM and pediatric IM dosing are tagged 'PCP:' in the monograph; pediatric IV dosing is tagged ACP only.
notesZh: 作用机制：非选择性抑制 COX-1 与 COX-2，进而抑制 prostaglandin（前列腺素），减轻疼痛、炎症和发热。
剂型：10 mg/mL 安瓿。
专论注明可参考 CPG E08 Pain Management（疼痛管理）及 ketorolac 的 Clinical Q&A 获取进一步指引。
授权等级说明：两条适应症、成人 IV/IM 剂量及儿科 IM 剂量在专论中均标注 'PCP:'；儿科 IV 剂量只标了 ACP。
examTipsEn: Exam tip: NOT on the EMALB licensing exam — licensing-exam answers follow the 18-drug EMALB Provincial Examination Guidelines. This is BCEHS PCP added-scope practice, taught and tested in the school (AET PCP) course.
Exam tip: anticoagulant use and pregnancy are contraindications, while an anti-inflammatory (e.g., ibuprofen) in the last 6-12 hours is a caution — always ask what the patient has already taken.
Exam tip: know the delivery details — 10 mg IM as a direct injection or IV undiluted over 15 seconds; repeat only after 6 hours (6-8 hours for children aged 2-11, IM only).
examTipsZh: 备考提示：本药不在 EMALB 执照考试范围内——执照考试一律按 EMALB《Provincial Examination Guidelines》的 18 种药作答；这里是 BCEHS 的 PCP 扩展执业（added scope）内容，属于学校（AET PCP）课程会教、也会考的部分。
备考提示：在用抗凝药、妊娠都是禁忌；而过去 6-12 小时内用过抗炎药（如 ibuprofen）只是 caution——给药前务必问清患者已经吃过什么。
备考提示：给药细节要记牢——10 mg IM 直接注射，或 IV 不稀释、15 秒推完；成人 6 小时后才能重复（2-11 岁儿童为 6-8 小时，且只能 IM）。

drugs.classificationEn: High alert medication; Controlled and targeted substance; General anesthetic
drugs.classificationZh: High alert medication（高警示药品）；Controlled and targeted substance（管制药品）；General anesthetic（全身麻醉药）
indicationsEn: Analgesia (intranasal) — PCP use requires BCEHS-specific education (Flight Training Program, including IN ketamine endorsement) and a mandatory consult prior to administration with 1) CCP-A 2) EPOS 3) CliniCall
indicationsZh: 镇痛（经鼻 IN 给药）——PCP 使用前必须完成 BCEHS 专项培训（Flight Training Program，含 IN ketamine 授权 endorsement），并在给药前强制咨询：1) CCP-A 2) EPOS 3) CliniCall（BCEHS 临床咨询热线）。
contraindicationsEn: Hypersensitivity to ketamine
Conditions where hypertension may be harmful, such as cerebral vascular accident or severe cardiac disease
PCP: age < 5 years
contraindicationsZh: 对 ketamine 过敏。
血压升高可能造成危害的情况，如脑血管意外（CVA）或严重心脏病。
PCP：年龄 < 5 岁。
cautionsEn: Severe hypertension (systolic BP > 180 mmHg)
Subarachnoid hemorrhage or epidural hematoma with severe hypertension
Myocardial ischemia or cardiac arrhythmias
cautionsZh: 严重高血压（收缩压 > 180 mmHg）。
Subarachnoid hemorrhage（蛛网膜下腔出血）或 epidural hematoma（硬膜外血肿）合并严重高血压。
心肌缺血或心律失常。

doseEn.adult: Initial dose 0.75 mg/kg IN (max dose 100 mg); usual dose 50-100 mg. Mandatory consult (CCP-A, EPOS, CliniCall) before administration.
doseEn.pediatric: Ages 5-11 years: 1 mg/kg IN (maximum 100 mg). Mandatory consult (CCP-A, EPOS, CliniCall) before administration.
doseEn.repeat: Adult: may repeat 0.5 mg/kg after 20 minutes. Pediatric: may repeat 1 mg/kg IN after 20 minutes prn. Further dosing as per consult.
doseEn.max: Single dose maximum 100 mg (adult and pediatric). No maximum cumulative dose.

doseZh.adult: 首剂 0.75 mg/kg IN（单次最大 100 mg）；常用量 50-100 mg。给药前必须先咨询（CCP-A、EPOS、CliniCall）。
doseZh.pediatric: 5-11 岁：1 mg/kg IN（最大 100 mg）。给药前必须先咨询（CCP-A、EPOS、CliniCall）。
doseZh.repeat: 成人：20 分钟后可重复 0.5 mg/kg。儿科：20 分钟后可按需重复 1 mg/kg IN。后续剂量按咨询意见执行。
doseZh.max: 单次最大 100 mg（成人与儿科相同）。无累计最大剂量。

drugs.onsetEn: Intranasal (analgesia): onset 5-10 minutes, peak 20 minutes, duration 45 minutes.
drugs.onsetZh: 经鼻（镇痛）：起效 5-10 分钟，峰值 20 分钟，持续 45 分钟。
sideEffectsEn: Transient increases or decreases in blood pressure and heart rate
Apnea and respiratory depression with rapid administration
Emergence reactions during recovery: vivid dreams, confusion, excitement, hallucinations
Laryngospasm — a known, rare complication; usually transient when it occurs
sideEffectsZh: 血压和心率一过性升高或降低。
给药过快可致 apnea（呼吸暂停）和呼吸抑制。
唾液分泌过多（hypersalivation）。
肌肉僵硬。
苏醒期可出现 emergence reaction（苏醒反应）：多梦且梦境逼真、意识混乱、兴奋、幻觉。
自发的不自主运动。
注射部位反应。
Laryngospasm（喉痉挛）——已知但少见的并发症，发生时通常是一过性的。
notesEn: Mechanism: interacts with NMDA receptors, opioid receptors, monoaminergic and muscarinic receptors, and voltage-sensitive Ca ion channels. Low doses cause analgesia; higher doses lead to dissociation.
Safety alert: account for the 0.1 mL dead space in the MAD so the intended dose is actually administered and documented. See PR11: Intranasal Medication Administration.
Overdose: the monograph advises considering midazolam for management of emergence symptoms.

Scope history: the BCEHS page source still contains hidden (commented-out, not displayed) older PCP text marked 'REMOVED FROM PCP SCOPE 2021-05-21; UPDATED GUIDELINE 2024-06-24' (e.g., pediatric 5-12 years 1.5 mg/kg IN). That superseded text is not used here — if older course notes quote it, the current displayed monograph wins.

Licence note: PCP — but only with BCEHS-specific Flight Training Program education and IN ketamine endorsement, plus the mandatory pre-administration consult. All IV/IO/IM ketamine (analgesia, procedural sedation, anesthesia, excited delirium) is ACP.
notesZh: 作用机制：作用于 NMDA 受体、阿片受体、单胺能受体、毒蕈碱受体及电压敏感钙通道。低剂量产生镇痛，高剂量导致 dissociation（分离麻醉状态）。
安全警示：计算剂量时要把 MAD（鼻腔黏膜雾化器）0.1 mL 的死腔算进去，确保实际给到并记录的是准确剂量。参见 PR11: Intranasal Medication Administration（经鼻给药操作规程）。
过量处理：专论建议苏醒期症状可考虑用 midazolam 处理。
范围沿革：BCEHS 网页源码里仍保留着一段被注释掉、页面上不显示的旧版 PCP 内容，标注『REMOVED FROM PCP SCOPE 2021-05-21; UPDATED GUIDELINE 2024-06-24』（如儿科 5-12 岁 1.5 mg/kg IN）。本条不采用这段已作废的内容——旧讲义若引用它，以现行显示的专论为准。
授权等级说明：属 PCP 范围，但前提是完成 BCEHS 的 Flight Training Program 专项培训并取得 IN ketamine 授权，且给药前必须咨询。所有 IV/IO/IM 途径（镇痛、操作镇静、麻醉诱导、excited delirium 兴奋性谵妄）都属于 ACP。
examTipsEn: Exam tip: NOT on the EMALB licensing exam — licensing-exam answers follow the 18-drug EMALB Provincial Examination Guidelines. This is BCEHS PCP added-scope practice, taught and tested in the school (AET PCP) course.
Exam tip: PCP ketamine is intranasal only and never without the endorsement and the mandatory consult (CCP-A, EPOS, CliniCall) — in a scenario, verbalize the consult before drawing it up.

Exam tip: age < 5 years is the PCP contraindication. Numbers to know: adult 0.75 mg/kg IN, pediatric (5-11 years) 1 mg/kg IN, single dose max 100 mg, repeats after 20 minutes, no maximum cumulative dose.
examTipsZh: 备考提示：本药不在 EMALB 执照考试范围内——执照考试一律按 EMALB《Provincial Examination Guidelines》的 18 种药作答；这里是 BCEHS 的 PCP 扩展执业（added scope）内容，属于学校（AET PCP）课程会教、也会考的部分。
备考提示：PCP 用 ketamine 只能经鼻，而且必须同时具备授权和给药前强制咨询（CCP-A、EPOS、CliniCall）——实操场景里先口述咨询，再抽药。
备考提示：年龄 < 5 岁是 PCP 禁忌。要背的数字：成人 0.75 mg/kg IN，儿科（5-11 岁）1 mg/kg IN，单次最大 100 mg，20 分钟后可重复，无累计上限。

drugs.classificationEn: High alert medication; Controlled and targeted substance; Opioid analgesic
drugs.classificationZh: High alert medication（高警示药品）；Controlled and targeted substance（管制药品）；Opioid analgesic（阿片类镇痛药）
indicationsEn: Pain management in palliative or end-of-life emergencies — mandatory CliniCall or palliative team consultation to discuss dosing strategies
Interfacility transport of patients in moderate to severe pain (intermittent IV/IO or infusion) — CCP-A consultation required
indicationsZh: Palliative（姑息治疗）或临终（end-of-life）急症中的疼痛处理——必须先咨询 CliniCall 或姑息治疗团队，商定给药方案。
院际转运（interfacility transport）中中度至重度疼痛的患者（间断 IV/IO 推注或持续输注）——必须咨询 CCP-A。
contraindicationsEn: Known hypersensitivity to morphine or other opioid analgesics
Head injury with altered LOC (GCS < 9)
Hypotension (adult SBP < 90 mmHg; children under 12 SBP < 70 mmHg)
Respiratory depression (adults < 10 breaths/minute; children under 12 < 20 breaths/minute)
Patients taking monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) or within 14 days of MAOI discontinuation (stated under Drug Interactions: 'Do not use')
contraindicationsZh: 对 morphine 或其他阿片类镇痛药已知过敏。
头部受伤伴意识改变（GCS < 9）。
低血压（成人收缩压 < 90 mmHg；12 岁以下儿童收缩压 < 70 mmHg）。
呼吸抑制（成人 < 10 次/分；12 岁以下儿童 < 20 次/分）。
正在服用 MAOI（单胺氧化酶抑制剂）或停用 MAOI 未满 14 天（原文写在 Drug Interactions 一栏：'Do not use'）。
cautionsEn: Convulsive disorders
Cranial injuries
Respiratory insufficiency, including asthma, COPD, and upper airway obstruction
Cardiac arrhythmias
Reduced blood volume (hypovolemia)
Respiratory and circulatory depression may be enhanced in combination with other opioids, sedatives such as benzodiazepines, phenothiazines, anesthetics, or alcohol
cautionsZh: 抽搐性疾病（convulsive disorders）。
颅脑损伤。
呼吸功能不全，包括哮喘、COPD 和上气道梗阻。
心律失常。
血容量减少（hypovolemia）。
与其他阿片类、benzodiazepines（苯二氮䓬类）等镇静药、phenothiazines（吩噻嗪类）、麻醉药或酒精合用时，呼吸和循环抑制可能加重。

doseEn.adult: Palliative/end-of-life: 2.5 - 5 mg subcut q 10-30 minutes prn, based on blood pressure (SBP > 100 mmHg), or as per CliniCall/palliative team care plan. Interfacility transport (CCP-A consult required): 2.5 - 5 mg IV/IO q 10-30 minutes prn; or infusion initial 2 mg/hour, usual range 0.5 - 10 mg/hour.
doseEn.repeat: q 10-30 minutes prn (palliative subcut and interfacility direct IV/IO)
doseEn.max: Palliative subcut: maximum 20 mg/hour. Interfacility direct IV/IO: maximum 10 mg/hour.

doseZh.adult: 姑息/临终：2.5 - 5 mg 皮下注射（subcut），按需每 10-30 分钟一次，以血压为依据（收缩压 > 100 mmHg），或按 CliniCall/姑息团队的护理计划。院际转运（须咨询 CCP-A）：2.5 - 5 mg IV/IO，按需每 10-30 分钟一次；或持续输注，起始 2 mg/小时，常用范围 0.5 - 10 mg/小时。
doseZh.repeat: 按需每 10-30 分钟（姑息皮下给药及院际转运 IV/IO 推注）。
doseZh.max: 姑息皮下给药：每小时最多 20 mg。院际转运 IV/IO 推注：每小时最多 10 mg。

drugs.onsetEn: IM/subcutaneous: onset 10 minutes, peak 20-60 minutes (variable), duration 2-4 hours. IV: onset 5-10 minutes, peak 20 minutes, duration 2-4 hours.
drugs.onsetZh: IM/皮下：起效 10 分钟，峰值 20-60 分钟（个体差异大），持续 2-4 小时。IV：起效 5-10 分钟，峰值 20 分钟，持续 2-4 小时。
sideEffectsEn: Profound hypotension (may be increased with rapid IV injection), bradycardia
Repeated subcutaneous administration may cause local tissue irritation
Pseudoallergic reactions (itch, rash) from direct stimulation of histamine release (anaphylaxis is rare)
sideEffectsZh: 嗜睡、头晕、镇静、躁动、欣快感。
呼吸抑制和 apnea（呼吸暂停）。
严重低血压（快速静推时可能更明显）、bradycardia（心动过缓）。
恶心、呕吐、便秘。
针尖样瞳孔（pinpoint pupils）。
反复皮下注射可引起局部组织刺激。
因直接刺激组胺释放而出现 pseudoallergic reaction（类过敏反应：瘙痒、皮疹）；真正的 anaphylaxis 少见。
notesEn: Mechanism: binds to opioid receptors in the CNS (primarily mu receptors), inhibiting ascending pain pathways, altering the perception of and response to pain, and producing generalized CNS depression.
How supplied: 10 mg in 1 mL ampoule. Standard adult direct concentration: 1 mg/mL (add 9 mL NS to 10 mg morphine).
Overdose: provide airway management and ventilatory support; consider naloxone. Use naloxone judiciously in patients on long-term opioid therapy to avoid precipitating acute withdrawal.

Licence note: the only PCP-tagged lines are palliative/end-of-life pain (subcut, mandatory CliniCall or palliative team consult) and interfacility transport (CCP-A consultation required). Routine moderate-to-severe pain IV dosing is tagged ACP/PCFP, and all pediatric dosing is ACP, CCP or PCFP — there is no pediatric PCP dose.
notesZh: 作用机制：与中枢神经系统的阿片受体（主要是 mu 受体）结合，抑制上行痛觉通路，改变对疼痛的感知与反应，并产生全面的中枢抑制。
剂型：1 mL 安瓿含 10 mg。成人推注标准浓度 1 mg/mL（10 mg morphine 加 9 mL NS）。
过量处理：保障气道、辅助通气，考虑使用 naloxone。长期使用阿片类药物的患者用 naloxone 要谨慎，以免诱发急性戒断。
授权等级说明：专论里标 PCP 的只有两处——姑息/临终疼痛（皮下给药，必须咨询 CliniCall 或姑息团队）和院际转运（必须咨询 CCP-A）。常规中重度疼痛的 IV 剂量标的是 ACP/PCFP，儿科剂量全部属于 ACP、CCP 或 PCFP——没有 PCP 儿科剂量。
examTipsEn: Exam tip: NOT on the EMALB licensing exam — licensing-exam answers follow the 18-drug EMALB Provincial Examination Guidelines. This is BCEHS PCP added-scope practice, taught and tested in the school (AET PCP) course.

Exam tip: know the 'do not give' numbers — head injury with GCS < 9; SBP < 90 (adult) or < 70 (child under 12); RR < 10 (adult) or < 20 (child under 12). The palliative subcut dose is also tied to SBP > 100 mmHg.

Exam tip: for a PCP, morphine is not a routine trauma-pain drug — it is palliative (subcut, CliniCall/palliative team) or interfacility transport (CCP-A consult). Keep the two hourly maxima apart: 20 mg/hour palliative subcut vs 10 mg/hour IFT direct IV/IO.
examTipsZh: 备考提示：本药不在 EMALB 执照考试范围内——执照考试一律按 EMALB《Provincial Examination Guidelines》的 18 种药作答；这里是 BCEHS 的 PCP 扩展执业（added scope）内容，属于学校（AET PCP）课程会教、也会考的部分。
备考提示：『不能给』的数字要背熟——头部受伤且 GCS < 9；收缩压成人 < 90、12 岁以下儿童 < 70；呼吸成人 < 10、12 岁以下儿童 < 20 次/分。姑息皮下给药还要求收缩压 > 100 mmHg。
备考提示：对 PCP 来说，morphine 不是常规创伤镇痛药——只用于姑息（皮下，咨询 CliniCall/姑息团队）或院际转运（咨询 CCP-A）。两个每小时上限别混：姑息皮下 20 mg/小时，院际转运 IV/IO 推注 10 mg/小时。

drugs.classificationEn: High alert medication; Controlled and targeted substance; Opioid analgesic
drugs.classificationZh: High alert medication（高警示药品）；Controlled and targeted substance（管制药品）；Opioid analgesic（阿片类镇痛药）
indicationsEn: Pain management in palliative or end-of-life patients (analgesia in palliative care settings) — CliniCall (or palliative care team) consultation required prior to selecting a dosing strategy
indicationsZh: 姑息或临终患者的疼痛处理（姑息治疗场景下的镇痛）——选择给药方案前必须咨询 CliniCall（或姑息治疗团队）。
contraindicationsEn: Allergy or known hypersensitivity to hydromorphone
contraindicationsZh: 对 hydromorphone 过敏或已知超敏反应。
cautionsEn: Causes respiratory depression; accumulation of carbon dioxide secondary to respiratory depression can potentiate the CNS depressant effects
Can cause or exacerbate hypotension
Can cause constipation
Use with caution in patients with other opioid sensitivity
Adjust dosing in hepatic disease — consult medical oversight or pharmacy for direction
Extended-release formulations have an extended duration of action
Depressant effects are potentiated by other CNS depressants such as alcohol, sedatives, antihistamines, neuroleptics, or psychotropic drugs
cautionsZh: 会引起呼吸抑制；呼吸抑制导致的 CO2 蓄积会进一步加强中枢抑制作用。
可引起或加重低血压。
可引起便秘。
对其他阿片类药物敏感的患者慎用。
肝病患者需调整剂量——请咨询 medical oversight（医疗监督）或药房。
缓释剂型作用时间更长。
与酒精、镇静药、抗组胺药、neuroleptics（抗精神病药）或精神类药物等其他中枢抑制剂合用时，抑制作用会叠加增强。

doseEn.adult: Palliative/end-of-life (CliniCall or palliative care team consult first): 2-4 mg PO q 4-6 hours; 0.2-1.0 mg IV q 2-3 hours; 1 mg SC q 4 hours.
doseEn.repeat: May repeat every 10-30 minutes as required based on blood pressure (> 100 mmHg), or as per CliniCall/palliative care team plan.

doseZh.adult: 姑息/临终（先咨询 CliniCall 或姑息治疗团队）：2-4 mg 口服，每 4-6 小时；0.2-1.0 mg IV，每 2-3 小时；1 mg 皮下（SC），每 4 小时。
doseZh.repeat: 可根据血压（> 100 mmHg）按需每 10-30 分钟重复，或按 CliniCall/姑息治疗团队的计划执行。

drugs.onsetEn: IV: onset 5 minutes, peak 10-20 minutes, duration 3-4 hours. Oral: onset 15-30 minutes, peak 30-60 minutes, duration 3-4 hours (13 hours for extended-release).
drugs.onsetZh: IV：起效 5 分钟，峰值 10-20 分钟，持续 3-4 小时。口服：起效 15-30 分钟，峰值 30-60 分钟，持续 3-4 小时（缓释剂型 13 小时）。
sideEffectsEn: Lightheadedness, dizziness, sedation, agitation, fear, delirium, hallucinations, drowsiness, disorientation
Profound hypotension, reflex tachycardia, bradycardia, palpitations, chest wall rigidity
sideEffectsZh: 头重脚轻、头晕、镇静、躁动、恐惧、谵妄、幻觉、嗜睡、定向障碍。
呼吸抑制和 apnea（呼吸暂停）。
严重低血压、反射性心动过速、心动过缓、心悸、胸壁僵硬（chest wall rigidity）。
恶心和呕吐。
notesEn: Mechanism: binds to opiate receptors in the CNS, inhibiting ascending pain pathways and altering the perception of and response to pain; produces generalized CNS depression.
How supplied: vial 2 mg/mL; bottle 10 mg/mL.
Overdose: provide airway management and ventilatory support; consider naloxone, used judiciously in patients on long-term opioid therapy to avoid precipitating acute withdrawal. See J12: Opioids.

Licence note: the indication 'Analgesia in palliative care settings' carries no level tag, and the adult palliative/end-of-life dosing block is tagged PCP. Interfacility-transport use is ACP; pediatric palliative dosing is ACP (requires specific training and licence endorsement); sedation/analgesia for ventilated patients is CCP — so there is no pediatric PCP dose.

Source ambiguity: the 'may repeat every 10-30 minutes based on blood pressure' line is printed directly under the PO line and does not say which route it applies to, even though the listed intervals are q 4-6 h (PO), q 2-3 h (IV) and q 4 h (SC). Follow the CliniCall/palliative care team plan.
notesZh: 作用机制：与中枢神经系统的阿片受体结合，抑制上行痛觉通路，改变对疼痛的感知与反应，并产生全面的中枢抑制。
剂型：小瓶 2 mg/mL；口服液瓶装 10 mg/mL。
过量处理：保障气道、辅助通气，考虑 naloxone；长期使用阿片类药物的患者要谨慎使用，以免诱发急性戒断。参见 J12: Opioids。
授权等级说明：适应症『姑息治疗场景下的镇痛』本身没有标等级，成人姑息/临终剂量一栏标注 PCP。院际转运用药属 ACP；儿科姑息剂量属 ACP（需专项培训及执照授权）；机械通气患者的镇静镇痛属 CCP——因此没有 PCP 儿科剂量。
原文含糊之处：『可根据血压每 10-30 分钟重复』这一行紧接在口服剂量下面，并未说明适用于哪种途径，而列出的给药间隔分别是口服每 4-6 小时、IV 每 2-3 小时、皮下每 4 小时。实际以 CliniCall/姑息团队的方案为准。
examTipsEn: Exam tip: NOT on the EMALB licensing exam — licensing-exam answers follow the 18-drug EMALB Provincial Examination Guidelines. This is BCEHS PCP added-scope practice, taught and tested in the school (AET PCP) course.

Exam tip: hydromorphone is the PCP palliative opioid that can go PO, IV or SC — but only after CliniCall or the palliative care team has been consulted to choose the dosing strategy. Repeats are tied to blood pressure (> 100 mmHg).
Exam tip: concentration trap — it is supplied both as a 2 mg/mL vial and a 10 mg/mL bottle; confirm which one you are holding before calculating a 0.2-1.0 mg IV dose.
examTipsZh: 备考提示：本药不在 EMALB 执照考试范围内——执照考试一律按 EMALB《Provincial Examination Guidelines》的 18 种药作答；这里是 BCEHS 的 PCP 扩展执业（added scope）内容，属于学校（AET PCP）课程会教、也会考的部分。
备考提示：hydromorphone 是 PCP 可用于姑息患者的阿片药，口服、IV、皮下三种途径都有——但必须先咨询 CliniCall 或姑息治疗团队来定方案。重复给药以血压（> 100 mmHg）为前提。
备考提示：浓度陷阱——有 2 mg/mL 小瓶和 10 mg/mL 瓶装两种规格；算 0.2-1.0 mg IV 剂量前，先确认手里拿的是哪一种。

drugs.classificationZh: Class IB antiarrhythmic（IB 类抗心律失常药）；Local anesthetic（局部麻醉药）
indicationsEn: Local anesthetic during intraosseous cannulation in conscious ADULT patients (12 years old and greater) — ONLY under direction of an on-scene ACP or higher
indicationsZh: 清醒的成人患者（12 岁及以上）进行 intraosseous（骨髓腔 / IO）穿刺时的局部麻醉——仅限在现场有 ACP 或更高级别人员指示下使用。
contraindicationsEn: Allergy or hypersensitivity to lidocaine
For systemic (IV/IO) administration, including IO anesthesia: third-degree AV block
For systemic (IV/IO) administration, including IO anesthesia: ventricular escape rhythms
For systemic (IV/IO) administration, including IO anesthesia: Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome
contraindicationsZh: 对 lidocaine 过敏或超敏反应。
全身给药（IV/IO，包括 IO 麻醉）时：third-degree AV block（三度房室传导阻滞）。
全身给药（IV/IO，包括 IO 麻醉）时：ventricular escape rhythm（室性逸搏心律）。
全身给药（IV/IO，包括 IO 麻醉）时：Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome（预激综合征，WPW）。
cautionsEn: Congestive heart failure: consider alternative agents; CliniCall consultation recommended to discuss care planning options
Risk of lidocaine toxicity is increased in patients taking cimetidine, ranitidine, or beta blockers
In patients taking disopyramide, lidocaine may precipitate bradycardia that can progress to cardiac arrest
cautionsZh: Congestive heart failure（充血性心力衰竭）：考虑换用其他药物；建议咨询 CliniCall 讨论处理方案。
正在服用 cimetidine、ranitidine 或 beta blocker（β 受体阻滞剂）的患者，lidocaine 中毒风险增加。
正在服用 disopyramide 的患者，lidocaine 可能诱发心动过缓，并可进展为心脏骤停。

doseEn.adult: 40 mg IO, instilled slowly over 120 seconds through the extension; allow it to dwell in the bone marrow cavity for 60 seconds, then slowly flush the IO with 5-10 mL normal saline.

doseZh.adult: 40 mg IO，经延长管在 120 秒内缓慢注入；让药液在骨髓腔内停留 60 秒，然后用 5-10 mL 生理盐水缓慢冲管。

drugs.onsetEn: IO: onset 1-4 minutes, peak 5-10 minutes, duration 20 minutes.
drugs.onsetZh: IO：起效 1-4 分钟，峰值 5-10 分钟，持续 20 分钟。
sideEffectsZh: 头晕、头重脚轻、嗜睡、言语含糊。
低血压。
肌肉抽动。
Paresthesia（感觉异常），尤其是手指或嘴唇。
Tinnitus（耳鸣）。
恶心或呕吐。
心律失常。
notesEn: Mechanism: a sodium channel blocker; decreases the duration of the action potential by shortening the period of repolarization.
How supplied: prefilled syringe 2% solution 20 mg/mL (100 mg in 5 mL).
Overdose: care is primarily supportive.

Licence note: the PCP indication and dose are both tagged 'ONLY under direction of an on-scene ACP or higher', and only for ADULT (12 years old and greater) IO cannulation in conscious patients. Pediatric IO lidocaine, antiarrhythmic use and awake-intubation anesthesia are ACP — there is no pediatric PCP dose.
notesZh: 作用机制：钠通道阻滞剂，通过缩短复极期来缩短动作电位时程。
剂型：预充式注射器，2% 溶液 20 mg/mL（5 mL 含 100 mg）。
过量处理：以支持治疗为主。
授权等级说明：PCP 的适应症和剂量都写明『仅限现场有 ACP 或更高级别人员指示』，且只限清醒成人（12 岁及以上）的 IO 穿刺。儿科 IO 麻醉、抗心律失常及清醒插管麻醉均属 ACP——没有 PCP 儿科剂量。
examTipsEn: Exam tip: NOT on the EMALB licensing exam — licensing-exam answers follow the 18-drug EMALB Provincial Examination Guidelines. This is BCEHS PCP added-scope practice, taught and tested in the school (AET PCP) course.
Exam tip: the PCP line has three locks — an on-scene ACP or higher directing it, a conscious patient, and age 12 or older. With no ACP on scene, a PCP does not give IO lidocaine.

Exam tip: sequence for a conscious IO: 40 mg slowly over 120 seconds, 60-second dwell, then a slow 5-10 mL NS flush. IO lidocaine counts as systemic, so third-degree AV block, ventricular escape rhythms and WPW still apply.
examTipsZh: 备考提示：本药不在 EMALB 执照考试范围内——执照考试一律按 EMALB《Provincial Examination Guidelines》的 18 种药作答；这里是 BCEHS 的 PCP 扩展执业（added scope）内容，属于学校（AET PCP）课程会教、也会考的部分。
备考提示：PCP 这条有三把锁——现场必须有 ACP 或更高级别人员指示、患者清醒、年龄 12 岁及以上。现场没有 ACP，PCP 就不能给 IO lidocaine。
备考提示：清醒患者 IO 的顺序：40 mg 在 120 秒内缓慢注入 → 停留 60 秒 → 5-10 mL NS 缓慢冲管。IO 给药算全身给药，所以三度房室阻滞、室性逸搏心律和 WPW 这些禁忌照样适用。

drugs.classificationZh: Systemic corticosteroid（全身性糖皮质激素）
indicationsEn: Acute adrenal crisis (see E02: Adrenal Crisis) — CliniCall consultation required prior to administration
indicationsZh: Acute adrenal crisis（急性肾上腺危象，参见 E02: Adrenal Crisis）——给药前必须咨询 CliniCall。
contraindicationsEn: Hypersensitivity to hydrocortisone or other corticosteroids
Systemic fungal infections
contraindicationsZh: 对 hydrocortisone 或其他 corticosteroids（糖皮质激素）过敏。
全身性真菌感染。
cautionsEn: May cause hypercortisolism, particularly in younger children or when used for long periods of time at higher doses
Use with caution in heart failure or hypertension: corticosteroids have been associated with fluid retention and electrolyte disturbance
Corticosteroids have been associated with myocardial rupture when used in acute myocardial infarction
Corticosteroids should not be administered for sepsis in the absence of shock
Interactions: may enhance GI ulceration and bleeding with NSAIDs and salicylates (and reduce salicylate levels); may decrease phenytoin levels; may enhance the anticoagulant effect of warfarin
cautionsZh: 可能引起 hypercortisolism（皮质醇增多症），尤其是幼儿或长期大剂量使用时。
心力衰竭或高血压患者慎用：糖皮质激素与液体潴留和电解质紊乱有关。
急性心肌梗死时使用糖皮质激素与 myocardial rupture（心肌破裂）有关联。
没有休克的 sepsis（脓毒症）不应使用糖皮质激素。
药物相互作用：与 NSAIDs 及 salicylates（水杨酸类）合用可加重消化道溃疡和出血（并降低水杨酸类血药浓度）；可降低 phenytoin 血药浓度；可增强 warfarin 的抗凝作用。

doseEn.adult: 100 mg direct over 1 minute. IV preferred; IM acceptable if IV access is unobtainable or otherwise delayed (large muscle such as vastus lateralis preferred; deltoid may cause subcutaneous atrophy).

doseZh.adult: 100 mg，1 分钟内推注。首选 IV；无法建立或延迟建立 IV 通路时可改 IM（首选大肌肉如 vastus lateralis 股外侧肌；注射三角肌可能引起皮下萎缩）。

drugs.onsetEn: IV: onset 1 hour; peak variable; duration variable.
drugs.onsetZh: IV：起效 1 小时；峰值与持续时间因人而异。
sideEffectsEn: Endocrine/metabolic: hyperglycemia, hypokalemia, fluid retention, sodium retention, adrenal suppression
Cardiovascular: hypertension, cardiac arrhythmia, bradycardia, tachycardia, cardiac failure (especially in susceptible patients)
Burning or tingling sensation, especially in the perineal area after IV injection
Increased susceptibility to infection; wound healing impairment
CNS/psychiatric: euphoria, emotional lability, insomnia, headache, seizure
GI: nausea, vomiting, peptic ulcer (with possible perforation and hemorrhage)
sideEffectsZh: 内分泌/代谢：高血糖、低钾血症、液体潴留、钠潴留、肾上腺抑制。
心血管：高血压、心律失常、心动过缓、心动过速、心力衰竭（易感患者尤甚）。
灼热或刺痛感，尤其是 IV 推注后会阴部位。
超敏反应：anaphylaxis（过敏性休克）、angioedema（血管性水肿）。
感染易感性增加；伤口愈合受损。
中枢/精神：欣快、情绪不稳、失眠、头痛、抽搐。
消化道：恶心、呕吐、消化性溃疡（可能穿孔和出血）。
notesEn: Mechanism: decreases inflammation by suppressing migration of polymorphonuclear leukocytes and reversing increased capillary membrane permeability.
How supplied: 100 mg/vial. Maximum administration rate is 200 mg/minute.
Pediatric: the monograph states CliniCall consultation is required prior to administration as limited data are available, and the only pediatric doses listed are CCP — no pediatric PCP dose.
The side-effect list above is a selection from the monograph's very long list (sourced from Lexicomp).

Licence note: PCP for acute adrenal crisis only. Severe septic shock, status asthmaticus and chronic renal insufficiency are CCP indications; CCP continues adrenal crisis care with a 200 mg/24 hours IV infusion after the PCP initial dose.
notesZh: 作用机制：抑制多形核白细胞迁移、逆转毛细血管膜通透性增高，从而减轻炎症。
剂型：每瓶 100 mg。最大给药速度 200 mg/分钟。
儿科：专论注明因资料有限，给药前必须咨询 CliniCall；且列出的儿科剂量全部属于 CCP——没有 PCP 儿科剂量。
上面的不良反应只是从专论那份极长的清单（来源 Lexicomp）中挑选的部分。
授权等级说明：PCP 只用于急性肾上腺危象。严重脓毒性休克、哮喘持续状态和慢性肾功能不全都是 CCP 适应症；CCP 在 PCP 首剂之后会接着以 200 mg/24 小时静脉输注维持。
examTipsEn: Exam tip: NOT on the EMALB licensing exam — licensing-exam answers follow the 18-drug EMALB Provincial Examination Guidelines. This is BCEHS PCP added-scope practice, taught and tested in the school (AET PCP) course.
Exam tip: PCP hydrocortisone = acute adrenal crisis only: 100 mg over 1 minute, IV preferred, IM only if IV is unobtainable or delayed — and CliniCall must be consulted first.
Exam tip: for IM, pick a large muscle such as vastus lateralis (the deltoid may cause subcutaneous atrophy); and remember steroids are not given for sepsis without shock.
examTipsZh: 备考提示：本药不在 EMALB 执照考试范围内——执照考试一律按 EMALB《Provincial Examination Guidelines》的 18 种药作答；这里是 BCEHS 的 PCP 扩展执业（added scope）内容，属于学校（AET PCP）课程会教、也会考的部分。
备考提示：PCP 的 hydrocortisone 只用于急性肾上腺危象：100 mg、1 分钟推完，首选 IV，IV 建立不了或会延误时才改 IM——而且必须先咨询 CliniCall。
备考提示：IM 选大肌肉如股外侧肌（三角肌可能导致皮下萎缩）；另外记住没有休克的脓毒症不用激素。

drugs.nameZh: Epinephrine 雾化吸入（肾上腺素，用于 croup 哮吼 / 喘鸣）
drugs.classificationZh: High alert medication（高警示药品）；Sympathomimetic（拟交感神经药）
indicationsEn: Stridor (secondary to croup or other infectious cause) in children over 6 months of age — assess with the Westley Croup Score; CliniCall consultation recommended; requires additional training
indicationsZh: 6 个月以上儿童因 croup（哮吼）或其他感染引起的 stridor（喘鸣）——用 Westley Croup Score（Westley 哮吼评分）评估；建议咨询 CliniCall；需经额外培训。
contraindicationsEn: There are no absolute contraindications to epinephrine use in life-threatening situations such as anaphylaxis
contraindicationsZh: 在 anaphylaxis 等危及生命的情况下，epinephrine 没有绝对禁忌症。
cautionsEn: Cardiovascular disease, hypertension, diabetes, hyperthyroid, cerebrovascular disease
Underlying coronary artery disease: patients may develop signs and symptoms of angina or myocardial ischemia
Significant tachydysrhythmias, or in the context of hypothermia
Beta-adrenergic blocking drugs can limit epinephrine's bronchodilating and inotropic effects; arrhythmias can develop in patients taking antiarrhythmic medications
cautionsZh: 心血管疾病、高血压、糖尿病、甲状腺功能亢进、脑血管疾病。
有冠心病基础的患者：可能出现心绞痛或心肌缺血的症状体征。
明显的快速性心律失常，或处于低体温状态。
β 受体阻滞剂会削弱 epinephrine 的支气管扩张和正性肌力作用；服用抗心律失常药的患者可能出现心律失常。

doseEn.pediatric: Children over 6 months with stridor (Westley Croup Score): 5 mg by nebulizer mask over 10-15 minutes. CliniCall consultation recommended.
doseEn.repeat: May repeat in 3 hours if required

doseZh.pediatric: 6 个月以上伴喘鸣的儿童（Westley 哮吼评分）：5 mg 经雾化面罩吸入，10-15 分钟内雾化完。建议咨询 CliniCall。
doseZh.repeat: 如需要，3 小时后可重复。

sideEffectsEn: Anxiety, tremor, dizziness, sweating, palpitations, headache, and nausea
Increased heart rate and blood pressure, and risk of arrhythmias
sideEffectsZh: 焦虑、震颤、头晕、出汗、心悸、头痛和恶心。
心率加快、血压升高，并有心律失常风险。
notesEn: Mechanism: acts on alpha- and beta-adrenergic receptors. Alpha activity produces vasoconstriction and reduces vascular permeability; beta activity relaxes bronchial smooth muscle and increases heart rate and contractility. Epinephrine also inhibits histamine release.
The monograph gives pharmacokinetics for IV and IM only — no onset/duration is listed for the nebulized route, so the onset field is left blank.
Warning: epinephrine vials must be stored in specially marked containers and never co-mingled with other medications in kits or bins; inadvertent administration can cause serious harm or death.

Scope note: this entry covers only the PCP nebulized croup/stridor use. IM epinephrine for anaphylaxis and severe bronchospasm is in the EMALB epinephrine entry; there is no adult nebulized PCP dose in the monograph.

Licence note: tagged 'PCP: Stridor (secondary to croup or other infectious cause) in children over 6 months of age'; the dose line adds 'Requires additional training' and CliniCall consultation recommended (recommended, not mandatory).
notesZh: 作用机制：作用于 alpha 和 beta 肾上腺素受体。alpha 作用使血管收缩、降低血管通透性；beta 作用松弛支气管平滑肌、加快心率并增强心肌收缩力。Epinephrine 还能抑制组胺释放。
专论只给出了 IV 和 IM 的药代动力学，雾化途径没有起效/持续时间数据，因此起效一栏留空。
警示：epinephrine 药瓶必须存放在专门标记的容器中，绝不能与药箱或药盒里的其他药物混放；误给可能造成严重伤害甚至死亡。
范围说明：本条只涵盖 PCP 雾化治疗哮吼/喘鸣。过敏性休克和严重支气管痉挛的 IM epinephrine 见 EMALB 的 epinephrine 条目；专论里没有成人雾化的 PCP 剂量。
授权等级说明：原文标注『PCP: Stridor (secondary to croup or other infectious cause) in children over 6 months of age』；剂量处另注明『Requires additional training』（需额外培训），并建议咨询 CliniCall（是建议，不是强制）。
examTipsEn: Exam tip: NOT on the EMALB licensing exam — licensing-exam answers follow the 18-drug EMALB Provincial Examination Guidelines. This is BCEHS PCP added-scope practice, taught and tested in the school (AET PCP) course.
Exam tip: nebulized epi for croup is pediatric only — children over 6 months with stridor — 5 mg by nebulizer mask over 10-15 minutes, and do not repeat sooner than 3 hours.
Exam tip: don't mix up the two PCP pediatric epinephrine routes in this monograph: 0.01 mg/kg IM (max 0.5 mg) for severe asthma/bronchospasm vs 5 mg nebulized for croup stridor.
examTipsZh: 备考提示：本药不在 EMALB 执照考试范围内——执照考试一律按 EMALB《Provincial Examination Guidelines》的 18 种药作答；这里是 BCEHS 的 PCP 扩展执业（added scope）内容，属于学校（AET PCP）课程会教、也会考的部分。
备考提示：雾化 epi 治哮吼只用于儿童——6 个月以上伴喘鸣——5 mg 经雾化面罩、10-15 分钟雾化完，3 小时内不重复。
备考提示：同一专论里 PCP 给儿童的两种 epinephrine 途径别搞混：严重哮喘/支气管痉挛是 0.01 mg/kg IM（最大 0.5 mg），哮吼喘鸣是雾化 5 mg。
